Interface ClientMod

public interface ClientMod
Entry point of an OpenVoxel ModLoader mod.

A mod is a jar in instance/mods with an openvoxel.mod.properties file: 

id=mymod                       # lowercase id: assets/<id>/lang, config/<id>.properties
name=My Mod
version=1.0.0
main=com.example.mymod.MyMod   # a public class implementing ClientMod with a no-arg constructor

The loader creates one instance per mod and calls the hooks below in this order. Every hook is optional (default methods) and receives the shared ModContext. Exceptions are caught and logged; they never stop the game or other mods. 

public final class MyMod implements ClientMod {
    @Override public void onLoad(ModContext ctx) {
        ctx.nativeBlock("mymod:ruby_block").name("Ruby Block").texture("assets/mymod/ruby_block.png").register();
        ctx.registerCommand("hello", "says hi", args -> ctx.chat("&aHello!"));
    }
}

  • Method Details

    • onLoad

      default void onLoad(ModContext context) throws Exception
      Called when the JVM starts, before the game window and the game's blocks exist. This is the place to register native blocks, commands, recipes and configuration. On a dedicated server (see ModContext.isServer()) only this hook runs.
      Parameters:
      context - shared ModLoader services
      Throws:
      Exception - anything; it is logged and the mod keeps running

    • onGameReady

      default void onGameReady(ModContext context) throws Exception
      Called once the engine exists (ModContext.engine() is not null), before any world is loaded. Register engine event listeners here.
      Parameters:
      context - shared ModLoader services
      Throws:
      Exception - anything; it is logged

    • onFrame

      default void onFrame(ModContext context) throws Exception
      Called every rendered frame on the main (OpenGL) thread, after the game drew its HUD. Draw overlays and poll input here; keep it cheap and never block (no network or disk I/O).
      Parameters:
      context - shared ModLoader services
      Throws:
      Exception - anything; it is logged

    • onShutdown

      default void onShutdown(ModContext context) throws Exception
      Called when the game closes. ModConfig files are saved automatically right before.
      Parameters:
      context - shared ModLoader services
      Throws:
      Exception - anything; it is logged
